handoffOutputs.description: Fetch last ID from last-chat-id.json (via code_execution), increment, and display updated file content as JSON (for manual local update)
Display bulleted list of affected file base names (derived from chat; no extensions/paths)
Display command to run scripts_flatten-files.ts (with defaults)
Display Git commands (hard-coded branch: refactor-phase1-flatten; separate code boxes)
commands: git commit -m "Handoff from chat [ID]: [brief overview from summary]"

handoffOutputs.description: Display chat summary as JSON (for manual Supabase upsert; derived from chat history). ALWAYS include the 'workflow_rule' field with the exact fixed value to propagate handoff discipline across chats.

schema.nxt: array of strings (include: 'Post-summary analysis: Scan context-triggers.json for active workflow triggers', 'Dynamically scan key workspace files using code_execution tool at chat start (files: package.json, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, app/layout.tsx, lib/ai-actions.ts, lib/ai-generate.ts, lib/supabase.ts, supabase-config.json, context-triggers.json). Summarize contents and override any static <DOCUMENT> tags.')
schema.workflow_rule: string (fixed mandatory value: "Workflow Rule: Do not initiate handoff workflow if query includes this chat summary JSON without an explicit request (e.g., 'Trigger handoff'). Treat as discussion input only; no prompts needed.")
